title: Royal Twisted — Four Towers
description: Four 2–10 contestant survival towers: classic jump/duck cadence, Ember vent-to-burst patterns, Frost duck-to-recover grip, and warned Storm gust bracing. Includes silent live bots, finite skill practice and four-stage Tour, captured-rule seeded replay and scoped records.

source.provenance: Imported v0.5 original and v0.4 archive remain unchanged. Active v0.7.0 retains locally bundled Three.js r180, adds local MIT GLTF loader and CC0 Kenney Castle Kit scenery with texture closure and hashes. See tests/evidence/worlds.json and source/assets/provenance.json.
